verdict.rationale: Every Gitea instance serves a machine-readable spec: a Swagger 2.0 document at /swagger.v1.json (342 paths) and an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /openapi3.v1.json. Both were live-verified on gitea.com, alongside a default-enabled Swagger UI. The probe 404s were against the docs.gitea.com site, not instance paths, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent community corroboration of spec usage, and a documented deprecation or backward-compatibility policy for the versioned spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: the Swagger 2.0 document at /swagger.v1.json (342 paths, basePath /api/v1) and an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /openapi3.v1.json
Every Gitea instance ships an interactive Swagger UI reference at /api/swagger
API Reference guide is auto-generated by swagger and available on: https://gitea.your.host/api/swagger
